results.title: Mali’s recapture of Kidal: strategic value and reality | Military Africa
results.snippet: On October 6, 2026, a Malian and Russian convoy, supported by auxiliary state-backed forces, retook control of Kidal, the regional capital, from Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) and the Azawad Liberation Front (FLA).
